# Demohub

> Demohub is demo scheduling software for independent grocery stores. Brands book and pay for in-store sampling demos on the store's own booking page, and the store sees every demo on one calendar.

Demohub is free for retailers at any number of locations, with no subscription and no setup fee. The brand pays a flat $10 booking fee per demo. A store may also charge its own demo fee, which is optional and is paid out to the store's bank account.

## What it does
- Each store gets a booking page where brands pick a location, a date and a time, and pay by card.
- A brand's certificate of insurance has to be on file before it can book, and the brand agrees to the store's demo guidelines when it books.
- Brands list the items they will sample, with name, UPC and distributor, so the store can have product on the shelf.
- Store staff get an email when a demo is confirmed, plus reminders a week before, three days before and on the morning of the demo.
- Every demo at every location shows on one calendar in the store's admin dashboard, and staff can view a read-only calendar without logging in.
- Brands keep one free profile that works at every store on Demohub.

## Who it is for
- Independent grocers, co-ops, natural food markets and specialty food shops that host brand sampling demos.
- Food and beverage brands, and the demo agencies that book on their behalf.
